## NYT::NFlow::EMalformedKafkaMessagePolicy {#NYT_NFlow_EMalformedKafkaMessagePolicy}

#|
|| Possible values | **Description** ||
|| `keep` | Emit one Flow message with `data = null` and the original record value in structured YSON in `unparsed`. ||
|| `drop` | Emit no Flow message for the record and continue reading. ||
|| `fail` | Fail processing; the record is read again after the job recovers. ||
